problem: The pricing hero SEO regression workflow used github.run_id as its concurrency key, so every invocation created a unique concurrency group and could not deduplicate superseded PR/ref work.
root_cause: The workflow implemented cancel-in-progress=true but paired it with a unique run identifier. This defeated the repository single-flight invariant and caused the canonical BRAIN backend regression test to fail.
prevention: Use stable PR identity for PR-triggered concurrency and stable ref identity for manual/ref execution.
Never use github.run_id in supersedable workflow concurrency groups.
Keep cancel-in-progress=true only with a reusable logical-flight key.
